page.overview:
Who is Wild Boar?

A Wild Boar drove a Razorback for a Cobra team of Night-Vipers led by the Baroness in the Latin American country of Sao Cristobel. Destro had sold a nuclear warhead to one side in a civil war but the carrying helicopter had been shot down. The Cobra team secured the warhead but a G.I. Joe team started the timer by remote control, forcing the Cobras to abandon the warhead. The Joes later deactivated the timer.

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Wild Boar was available in the 1989 series of Real American Hero toys, boxed with the Razorback vehicle. ---- Appearance: black head covering with gold goggles; red shirt and pants; black vest, belt and boots
